Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Creates the generators that [PgPropertyRunner](/api/ankus.pgpropertyrunner/) draws inputs from, like proptest's built-in strategies.

```csharp
public static class PgGenerators
```

Integers sometimes take their range's limits so edge cases appear early, and they shrink toward zero, or toward the
limit nearest zero when the range excludes it, preferring positive values. Text holds Unicode scalar values other
than NUL, which PostgreSQL text cannot store, and favors ASCII letters and digits.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### FloatingPoint&lt;T&gt;()

Produces any value of a binary floating-point type, such as [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double) or [float](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.single),
including infinities, NaN, negative zero and subnormal values, shrinking toward small whole numbers.

```csharp
public static PgGenerator<T> FloatingPoint<T>() where T : IBinaryFloatingPointIeee754<T>, IMinMaxValue<T>
```

Type parameters:

`T`

[double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double), [float](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.single) or [Half](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.half).

Returns: <code>PgGenerator&lt;T&gt;</code>

The generator.

Exceptions:

- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): <code class="typeparamref">T</code> is another floating-point type.

Produces any value of an integer type, such as [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32), [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64) or [byte](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte).

```csharp

```

Type parameters:

`T`

Exceptions:
